name: Rwandan law: the Constitution (from its 2015 revision) and the general statute governing public servants
label: Rwanda
record_note: Constitution from the 2015 revision (2003-2010 texts are scans without a text layer), replaced as a whole by the 2023 revising act; Law n° 017/2020 with three amending laws replayed. English column of the trilingual Official Gazette; data retrieved 2026-10-28.

scope.when_absent: no scope note is recorded in this history; not a statement that a change reaches every case

default_reach.rule: laws apply from publication; criminal law is not retroactive
default_reach.meaning: a law cannot enter into force before it is published; no one may be punished for an act that was not an offence when committed. A law may still state an earlier effect (Law n° 019/2020: "takes effects as of 8 October 2020")
default_reach.authority: Constitution of the Republic of Rwanda (2023), Article 174(1) and Article 29(1)(d); Article 138(1) ("the principle of non- retroactivity of criminal law")
